# Identity overrides for the public snapshot (git mailmap format, read by git-filter-repo --mailmap).
#
#   Proper Name <proper@email> Old Name <old@email>
#
# DEFAULTS are generated by run.sh from the history and need no entries here:
#   - the identity that authored most commits  ->  GM-Hrishi <GM-Hrishi@users.noreply.github.com>
#   - every other author or committer identity  ->  OneVision team member <team@onevision.invalid>
#   - unchanged: noreply@github.com, noreply@anthropic.com and any *@users.noreply.github.com
# The old identities are deliberately not written in this file, so no personal email is added to the repository.
# run.sh lists the old identities by NAME ONLY when it runs.
#
# An entry below overrides the default for that old email address (matched case-insensitively).
#
# To credit a teammate with their real GitHub account, add one line per old identity. Use a noreply address only
# for a handle you are SURE about: a wrong handle attributes commits to someone else's real account.
#
# Example (placeholders, not real):
# Teammate Display Name <teammate-handle@users.noreply.github.com> Old Name <old.address@example.org>
